verdict.rationale: GA4 ships an official MCP server and a Data API that an agent can use to query key metrics, including batch, pivot, realtime and funnel reports, and the docs explicitly name building custom dashboards as a Data API use case. However, the evidence shows only read access to report data. Nothing shows an API or MCP tool that creates or saves dashboards or reports inside GA4, and the Admin API covers configuration, not dashboards. The agent would therefore have to render the dashboard in an external tool, so the story is not delivered end-to-end. missing for 10: API/MCP capability to create and persist dashboards or reports within GA4, evidence of the MCP server's tool scope, hands-on corroboration of an agent building a dashboard end-to-end.
